انتزعت (form VIII)
# اِنْتَزَعْتُ (intazaʕtu) /in.ta.zaʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# اِنْتَزَعْتَ (intazaʕta) /in.ta.zaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# اِنْتَزَعْتِ (intazaʕti) /in.ta.zaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# اِنْتَزَعَتْ (intazaʕat) /in.ta.za.ʕat/: third-perso
